cd "C:/visual projects/alpha" && TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && B=/c/scratch/tk349-$TS && mkdir -p $B && echo $B > /tmp/tk349_b.txt && 
{ git ls-files -m; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard -- .claude CLAUDE.md; } | sort -u > $B/files.txt && wc -l $B/files.txt &&
git rev-parse HEAD > $B/HEAD && git status --porcelain -uall > $B/status.txt && git diff > $B/local.patch &&
while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f"; done < $B/files.txt > $B/files-exist.txt && wc -l $B/files-exist.txt &&
tar -cf $B/live.tar -T $B/files-exist.txt && ls -la $B

cd "C:/visual projects/alpha" && cat > /c/scratch/tk349-0916/manifest.py <<'EOF'
import hashlib, sys
src, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
n = 0
with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as o:
    for line in open(src, encoding="utf-8"):
        p = line.rstrip("\n")
        if p.startswith(".claude/worktrees/") or p.startswith("data/"):
            continue
        try:
            b = open(p, "rb").read().replace(b"\r", b"")
        except OSError:
            continue
        o.write(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() + "  " + p + "\n"); n += 1
print(n)
EOF
python -I /c/scratch/tk349-0916/manifest.py /c/scratch/tk349-0916/files-exist.txt /c/scratch/tk349-0916/manifest-before.sha256 && git branch -f master origin/master && git rev-parse master

cd "C:/visual projects/alpha" && OURS=".claude/dispatcher/ceo-restart-services.py .claude/roles/notes/ceo.md .claude/settings.json .claude/tickets/TK-231.md .claude/tickets/TK-237.md" && for f in $OURS; do git checkout --ours -- "$f" && git add -- "$f"; done 2>&1 | grep -v "^warning"; for f in $(grep -vxF -e .claude/dispatcher/ceo-restart-services.py -e .claude/roles/notes/ceo.md -e .claude/settings.json -e .claude/tickets/TK-231.md -e .claude/tickets/TK-237.md /c/scratch/tk349-0916/conflicts.txt); do git checkout --theirs -- "$f" && git add -- "$f"; done 2>&1 | grep -v "^warning"; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | wc -l; git diff --cached --name-only origin/master | head -40
cd "C:/visual projects/alpha" && git checkout --ours .claude/settings.json 2>&1 | grep -v "^warning"; git add .claude/settings.json; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | wc -l
